title: Verify
does: Runs every finding's probe on a fresh sandbox. Pass makes it Seen, fail refutes it. Routes no finding explains become unknowns.

tools.name: Probe runner
tools.purpose: runs each rule's test from a fresh state and compares status, body and headers

tools.name: psql
tools.purpose: puts the database back to a known state before each run and each test

tools.name: Node fetch
tools.purpose: sends each request and records the response; adds a traceparent header so traces can be matched to it

tools.name: Node child_process
tools.purpose: starts and stops the service under test

tools.name: Playwright (Chrome)
tools.purpose: runs each UI rule in a real browser: opens the screen, fills fields by label, clicks, checks the visible text and the API calls

lines.msg: each probe runs on a fresh sandbox: reset data, run the fixtures, run any setup steps, then the probe request
transfers-F20: no probe, capped at Inferred: Each transfer writes ledger entries: a debit for the amount and a debit for the fee on the sender, plus a credit on the receiver only when completed.
ui-F1: in Chrome: open /#/wallets → (no message) → Seen
ui-F3: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id → (no message) → Seen
ui-F4: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, Amount="3000" → (no message) → Seen
ui-F5: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, Amount="50" → (no message) → Seen
ui-F6: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="0", click Send money → Enter an amount above 0. → Seen
ui-F7: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="1.005", click Send money → Use at most 2 decimals. → Seen
ui-F8: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="100", click Send money → Sent 100.00 USD to bob. Fee 1.00 USD. → Seen
ui-F9: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="5000", click Send money → Transfer of 5,000.00 USD to bob is waiting for review. Fee 25.00 USD was charged. → Seen
ui-F10: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="10000.01", click Send money → Daily limit reached. You can still send 10,000.00 USD today. → Seen
ui-F11: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="carol", Amount="50", click Send money → Both wallets must use the same currency. → Seen
ui-F12: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="alice", Amount="10", click Send money → Not enough balance to cover the amount and the fee. → Seen
ui-F13: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="205", click Send money → Sent 205.00 USD to bob. Fee 1.03 USD. → Seen
ui-F14: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="4.35", click Send money → Check the amount and try again. → Seen

ui-F16: in Chrome: open /#/send/:id, To="bob", Amount="1,000", click Send money → Enter an amount above 0. → refuted (text not shown: "Sent 1,000.00 USD to bob."; no POST /transfers 201 request), back to analysis
coverage: every traced route and screen (8) is explained by at least one finding
